title: VakilnaSEEG-fingerprint: sEEG seizure-onset and interictal segments of one polymicrogyria patient with electrode coordinates (Vakilna et al., 2025) (derivative)
description: A derivative sEEG dataset from one patient with extensive bilateral perisylvian polymicrogyria and intractable focal seizures. It contains short sensor-space segments of seizure onset and interictal spikes in monopolar and bipolar montages, with electrode coordinates for 228 located depth contacts. The data support source-space time-frequency fingerprint analysis for localizing the epileptogenic zone.
methods_description: Clinical stereo-EEG was recorded with a Nihon Kohden EEG-1200A at 2000 Hz. The authors imported it into Brainstorm, notch-filtered the 180-900 Hz harmonics and resampled to 1000 Hz. Segments were repackaged as BrainVision float32 in microvolts, with Brainstorm events converted to events.tsv and channel locations (SCS) to electrodes.tsv.
